name: YONFER Agricultural Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: YONFER Agricultural Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and marketing of fertilizers in China. The company provides phosphate and compound fertilizers, such as MAP fertilizers, slow and controlled release fertilizers, compound fertilizers, and water-soluble fertilizers; new energy materials; fine chemicals; and phosphogypsum building materials. It also offers agrochemical services. In addition, the company exports its products. It sells its products under the Yonfer, AUTTLER, LEKAIHUAI, RESINO, and other brands.
